title: BMI versus foot plumpness index
indexCaption: Charted as 脚长/脚宽 on the original panel; values sit in the 20–30 range and rise with BMI.
notes: The donut percents reuse the original placeholder arithmetic (value / (value + placeholder)).
A higher index tracks higher BMI in both series, so the panel is read as 'heavier children, thicker-looking feet' rather than a raw length/width ratio.
